transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. — it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you, too. Um... I hope I'm not wasting your time being here, I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in. 

It's mostly just some stress at work. I drive for a living, and... well, I really don't want to sound like a complainer or anything, but dispatch and compliance, they've been tracking my route changes. Like, through the computer system, and I keep hearing these little comments on the radio about it. 

I mean, when I bring it up, people say it’s just normal oversight, and maybe they're right, I don't want to make a big deal out of nothing... but I can just tell certain other drivers are reporting on me. Does that make sense? I just hope I'm explaining it okay for you.
When you hear those comments on the radio, do they seem like they are really meant for you?

Um... yes. Well, I think so. I really hope I don't sound paranoid or anything, I know how that comes across and I don't want you to think I'm crazy. 

But it’s just... when they make those little comments on the radio, it lines up exactly with what the computer system is tracking about my route changes. Like, I’ll take a different street to avoid traffic, and suddenly someone on the radio makes a joke about a driver taking the scenic route or going off the grid. 

I know people tell me it’s just normal oversight from dispatch, and I really try to believe them—I always try to be a good employee and I definitely don't want to cause any problems at work. But... I can just tell that certain other drivers are reporting on me to compliance. They're watching what I do and sending it up the chain. 

Does that sound totally unreasonable? I really hope I'm just overthinking it, but it just feels so directed at me.
Do you think there is actually a coordinated effort at work to watch and report on you, or could it just be a misinterpretation on your part?

I... I really wish it was just me misinterpreting things, Doctor. And I always try to look at my own faults first, I promise. I want to be a good employee. But... well, like I was saying before, it just feels so coordinated. 

The way dispatch and compliance track the route changes on the computer system, and then those little radio comments follow right after... it's just too exact to be a coincidence. I know I should just accept it when people tell me it's just normal oversight, and I really am trying to be a good sport about it, I swear. But even when they say that, I can just tell that certain drivers are definitely watching me and reporting on me. 

I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds like I'm not taking feedback well or being difficult, and I really, really don't want to be that kind of person. Am I making too big a deal out of this? I really value your opinion on it, I just want to make sure I'm looking at this the right way.
Have you always been this suspicious of other people, or is this a new change for you?

Oh, no, definitely not always. I really try to be a trusting person, and I usually get along great with all my coworkers. I'd hate for you to think I'm just naturally suspicious or looking for trouble... I'm really not, I promise. 

It's just... well, this specific thing with the tracking through the computer system and those radio comments, it's only really felt clear to me for about the past two months. Before that, everything was totally fine and I never had any issues with anyone. I just started noticing it recently, and... well, I hope it's okay that I brought it up. Is two months a normal amount of time to be stressed out about something like this?
Have you had any other unusual experiences, like hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

Oh, no, no... definitely not. I've never had anything like that happen. 

I mean, I know the radio thing I was talking about probably sounds a little strange, but it's coming from the actual physical radio in the truck, I promise. It's not voices in my head or anything like that. I really hope you don't think I'm losing touch with reality... I'm definitely not seeing visions or hearing things that aren't there. 

That's a good sign, right? I just really want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information and not making you think I'm completely crazy.
Have you generally been suspicious of other people in most areas of your life, not just at work?

Oh, no, definitely not. I really try my best to see the good in people, I promise. Outside of work, I don't have any issues like this at all. I have a good group of friends, and I get along with my family... I'm usually the one who trusts people a little too much, if anything. 

I'd hate for you to think I'm just a paranoid person who thinks everyone is out to get me. I'm really not like that. It's just this one specific situation at work that's been so stressful. I'm usually very easygoing. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that right. I just want to be sure you know I'm usually very trusting.
Have you ever had a similar belief that other people were watching, judging, or talking about you in the past?

Oh, no, never. Nothing like this at all. I mean, maybe just the normal... you know, wondering if you said something silly in a conversation or hoping you made a good impression, but never feeling like people were actually watching me or secretly talking about me. 

I've always been really level-headed, I promise. This is all completely new for me. I really hope you believe me on that, because I'd hate for you to think I have a history of... well, of being paranoid or making things up. I've always had a really good grip on things until this stuff at work started. 

That's a good thing, right? That I've never had any issues like this in the past? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how I usually am.
Before these last two months, have you usually had trouble trusting other people?

No, not at all. Like I was just saying a minute ago, I've always been the kind of person who trusts people right off the bat. Before these last couple of months, I never had any issues with that whatsoever. 

I've always been really open and... well, friendly, I think. I've never had a reason to doubt my friends or my family or anyone else before this. I just really want to make sure you understand that this isn't how I normally am. I've always been a trusting person, and I really pride myself on being easy to get along with. 

I hope I'm being helpful by explaining it that way... I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know. I'm answering these okay, right?
Before these last two months, did you usually have trouble trusting people in close relationships, like friends, family, or coworkers?

Oh, um, no... not at all. It's kind of like I was just saying, I really haven't ever had trouble trusting the people close to me. My family and I are very close, and my friends are wonderful. And my coworkers, well, before these last couple of months, everything was completely fine there, too. I've always felt very secure with the people in my life. 

I'm sorry, I feel like I'm repeating myself a little bit... did I misunderstand the last question? I really don't mean to sound like a broken record. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the answers you need. Am I doing this right?
Do you think there is any real possibility that your coworkers are not actually watching or reporting on you?

Well, I... I mean, I try to look at it from all sides, I really do. I don't want to seem like I'm just jumping to conclusions or being unreasonable. But... it's just so hard to ignore what's right in front of me. 

I know people say it's just normal oversight, you know, just part of the job. But I'm really only here because dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes through the computer system. And it's not just that—there are these little comments on the radio, too. And even when everyone tries to tell me it's fine, I can just tell that certain drivers are reporting on me. 

I'm sorry if that sounds a bit... much. I really don't want you to think I'm being difficult or stubborn about it. I just can't shake the feeling that it's actually happening. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay without sounding too crazy...
Before these last two months, did you usually have trouble trusting people in close relationships, like friends, family, or coworkers?

Um, I feel like... maybe we just talked about this? I'm so sorry, I don't want to be annoying or anything, but I think I just answered this one. Like I said, I've always trusted my family and friends and everyone at work... at least, until recently. 

I'm really trying my best to give you the right answers. Did I not explain it well enough before? I can try to say it differently if that helps... I just really want to make sure I'm doing a good job for you.
Have you ever felt that people were intentionally trying to harm, deceive, or take advantage of you in other situations outside of work?

Um, no, not really. Outside of work, I haven't felt like anyone was trying to hurt me or trick me or anything like that. My life outside the job is pretty quiet, honestly. I mostly just stick to my normal routine and spend time with people I know. 

I really try to see the best in people, you know? I'm not the kind of person who goes around thinking everyone is out to get me. I hope I don't come across that way... because I'm really not like that. Does that answer what you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things are.
Have you had any problems with social relationships or holding onto jobs because of distrust or suspiciousness over many years?

Oh, no, definitely not. I've actually always been really good at keeping my jobs, I promise. I take a lot of pride in being a reliable worker, and... well, I've never been fired for anything like that or had trouble staying employed. 

And with my friends, I've always had a nice, steady group. I really try to be easy to get along with, you know? I don't want you to think I'm this difficult person who just argues with everyone or pushes people away, because I really do try my best to be good to the people around me. I've never had long-term issues like that. 

Is that what you were asking? I just want to make sure I'm answering it right for you and giving you what you need.
Since this started two months ago, has it affected your ability to work or manage your daily life?

Um, well... I really try to keep everything running smoothly, I promise I do. I want to be good at my job. But... I guess things have been a little harder lately. 

I've fallen a bit behind on my route reports at work. And, um, I guess some of the drivers have complained that my instructions are getting a little confusing. I hate that they're upset, I really didn't mean to mess anything up. I'm trying so hard to fix it. 

And at home... I feel really bad about this, but my husband has had to take over a lot of the stuff I usually do. Like making meals, handling phone calls, just basic planning things. I just haven't been able to keep up like I normally do. I feel awful putting that on him. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound terrible. I really am trying to get back on track, I promise. Is that... is that the kind of information you needed? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right details.
Is there any chance that what you’re noticing at work is actually happening the way you think it is?

Um... well, I know it sounds a little... intense, when I say it out loud. And I really don't want to seem like I'm just making things up or overreacting, because I'm not that kind of person. But... yes, I really do think it's happening. 

I'm here because... well, dispatch and compliance, they've been tracking my route changes through the computer system. And I hear these little comments on the radio, too. People keep telling me it's just normal oversight, you know, just standard procedure... but I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me. I just know they are. 

I really hope that doesn't make me sound crazy or difficult. I'm just trying to explain what I've been noticing. Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answer.
Have these beliefs and concerns been going on for at least one month?

Um, yes... it's been going on for a little while now. I'd say... well, the tracking through the computer system and those comments on the radio, they've felt really clear to me for about the past two months. 

I know that might sound like a long time to be worrying about this, and I really tried to just ignore it at first. I didn't want to make a big deal out of nothing or cause any trouble at work. But it just hasn't stopped, you know? 

I hope it's okay that I waited a bit to get help... I just wanted to be absolutely sure before I said anything to a doctor. Did I give you the right timeframe? I want to make sure I'm being helpful.
Before these last two months, did you often suspect that other people had hidden motives or were trying to deceive you?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I've always tried to get along with everyone. I'm usually the kind of person who trusts people, you know? I really prefer to see the good in others. 

Before all this started a couple of months ago, I never really worried about people having hidden motives or anything like that. I just went to work, did my job, and came home. I didn't want any drama. 

I hope that's a good thing? I just... I don't want you to think I'm normally a suspicious or difficult person, because I'm really not. Is that the kind of background information you were looking for?
Have these beliefs about your coworkers watching or reporting on you been going on for at least six months?

Well, um... I guess if I really think about it, it's... it's been a bit longer than I first said. I'm sorry, I wasn't trying to hide anything, I just... I didn't want to seem like I've been struggling for too long. 

But, yes, it's actually been building up for... maybe about eight months now? It started right around the time they put me in that temporary dispatch lead role. I just... I didn't want to admit it had been going on that long because I should have been able to handle the promotion better, you know? 

I really hope you don't think less of me for not bringing it up sooner. I just wanted to do a good job and not complain. Is... is it okay that I corrected the timeline? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information now.
Have you noticed any major changes in your thinking or speech, like trouble keeping your thoughts organized or others saying you seem hard to follow?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I try really hard to make sure I'm communicating clearly, especially at work. Dispatch is all about being clear, right? 

I haven't had anyone tell me I'm hard to follow or anything like that. Sometimes I might pause to make sure I'm saying the right thing, like I am now, because I want to be helpful and give you the right answers. But my thoughts feel pretty organized to me. 

I really try to stay focused and not let things get jumbled. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining myself well enough for you.
Before this recent problem at work began, were you ever this distrustful or suspicious of people in your close relationships?

Um, no, definitely not. With my close friends and family, I've always been an open book. I mean, I really value the people in my life, and I always want them to know they can trust me, just like I trust them. 

I've never had any reason to doubt my family or my close friends. I've always tried to be the kind of person who is supportive and easy to get along with. I wouldn't want to cause any friction in my personal relationships. 

Does that sound normal to you? I just want to make sure you know that I'm usually a very trusting person in my personal life. I really hope that helps clarify things.
